evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes then I'll be able to build you an accurate code you can depend on sounds good.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: I'd like to ask first what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Roger raises: (1) cost concern — Nicole acknowledges with 'Mm-hmm' and moves into virtual walkthrough offer; (2) pod necessity concern — Roger explains in detail about rooms not being refinished, Nicole reflects 'we can definitely move it to the other parts of your home. So, so that you don't need to get about if that's the case' and offers to discuss further in the walkthrough.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Nicole summarizes Roger's pod concern: 'we can definitely move it to the other parts of your home' but does not do a full 'So what I'm hearing is X, Y, Z—did I get it all?' reflection.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Nicole correctly identifies the move as complex (furniture relocation, potential pod question, special layout) and offers: 'we can do a virtual walkthrough, it's like a video call on your preferred time and date. So we can identify how many movers you will be needing to move your items into a pod.' Roger accepts, and Nicole confirms the time (tomorrow 4:30 PM) and sends a secure link.

top_strength: Nicole correctly routed this call to a virtual walkthrough instead of forcing a same-call quote, and she followed up on Roger's stated concerns (pod necessity, room layout) with acknowledgment and a clear explanation of how the walkthrough would address them.
coaching_note: Nicole missed packing services and box count entirely (Section 3), and did not complete a full active-listening summary loop in Section 2 — a short phrase like 'So what I'm hearing is you need to figure out pod vs. in-home storage, and want to make sure we can handle the layout—did I get that right?' would have closed the loop more cleanly before moving to the walkthrough offer.
